options: The hashed customer list you upload for matching
The approach where your signals are suggestions and the system finds who converts
The automatic delivery of the ad across every available surface in Meta
The bid strategy that maximizes conversion value within budget
questions.explanation: Advantage+ Audience takes your signals as a starting point and widens the search toward whoever is most likely to convert. The hashed list is a custom audience; surfaces are placements.

questions.q: A custom audience is built with:
options: Generic interests and behaviors from detailed targeting
The largest-percentage lookalikes available per country
People with a previous relationship to the business (web, app, list, engagement)
The audiences automatically suggested by the Advantage+ Audience system
questions.explanation: Custom audience = people who ALREADY interacted with you: visited your site, used your app, are on your list or engaged with your content.

options: The 1% gives more reach with less similarity; the 10% gives higher matching precision with fewer people
The 1% is most similar to the seed with less reach; the 10% expands reach losing similarity
They are the same size; only the source country changes
The 1% requires an active Pixel and the 10% requires a customer list
questions.explanation: The percentage is how far you stray from the seed: 1% = the most similar (fewer people), 10% = more reach with lower similarity.

questions.q: Typical symptom of over-targeting (an audience that's too small):
options: Low CPM with high delivery but expensive conversions
More conversions with less spend during the learning phase
High recall but low clicks across all surfaces
Nearly zero delivery with high CPM and stalled learning
questions.explanation: A tiny audience = few available auctions: the system has no one to deliver to, CPM spikes and the learning phase never ends.

questions.q: A regulated-sector client that by law can NOT show ads outside a defined audience:
options: Advantage+ Audience with strong signals as suggestions
Original audience with defined targeting and no expansion
Lookalike 10% seeded from the current customer list
Detailed targeting expansion enabled with block lists
questions.explanation: Legal restriction = strict control: original audience without expansion. Advantage+ and expansions can step outside the allowed audience.

questions.q: An ecommerce wants to win back people who added to cart without buying in the last 7 days:
options: A lookalike 1% of the last year's buyers
A website custom audience (AddToCart 7 days) excluding buyers
Advantage+ Audience with no signals, keeping the search as broad as possible
Detailed targeting on the 'online shopping' interest
questions.explanation: Pure remarketing: website source with the 7-day AddToCart event, excluding Purchase so you don't spend on people who already bought.

questions.q: The ideal seed for a high-value lookalike:
options: All site visitors from the last 180 days
A saved audience with broad interests from the industry
A quality custom audience (e.g. buyers or top customers)
The audience from a previous Awareness campaign
questions.explanation: The lookalike's quality depends on the seed: start from your BEST customers, not general traffic. Garbage in, garbage out.

questions.q: The four custom audience sources are:
options: Website, App activity, Customer list and Engagement
Pixel, CAPI, dataset and connected catalog
Feed, Stories, Reels and Audience Network
Awareness, Traffic, Leads and Sales
questions.explanation: The 4 sources: website activity, app activity, customer list and engagement with your content on Meta. The rest are signals, surfaces and objectives.

questions.q: When is an original audience better than Advantage+ Audience?
options: Whenever there's a large budget available to scale
When the Pixel signal is strong, mature and with events arriving steadily
When you're seeking the lowest possible cost per result
With regulatory restrictions or a need for strict audience control
questions.explanation: The recommended default is Advantage+; the original audience is reserved for strict control: regulation, brand safety or controlled tests.

questions.q: A base of 40,000 customers to start new prospecting. First move?
options: Upload it hashed and use it directly as the target audience for the new prospecting
Upload it hashed as a custom audience and build a lookalike, excluding current customers
Turn it into detailed targeting using those customers' common interests
Use it only as an exclusion list to avoid spending on current customers
questions.explanation: The list is CURRENT customers (not prospecting): it works as a lookalike seed and as an exclusion. Using it directly would talk to people who already bought.
